name: Wailing Caverns: the Disciple of Naralex starts the event before the Fanglords die (#7626)
contract: On live CoA the Disciple of Naralex 3678 at the entrance offered 'Let the event begin!' (gossip menu 201)
without Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, Lord Pythas or Lord Serpentis dead: the 2026-05-27 and 2026-06-08
combat logs show Mark of Naralex and the escort with only Anacondra killed during it, then Mutanus 3654.
Mythic+ 'Pit of the Fangs' (TimedDungeons 3318) needs Mutanus but not Pythas or Serpentis, who stand in the
other wing. In a fresh instance the option must therefore be offered.
